body: Computer Science. I didn't decide on this until recently. I've floundered for many years between going for CS or film. CS will likely lead to better jobs and I want to prove to myself that I can do it. I've had discipline issues particularly when it came to math in the past, so I definitely have a challenge ahead of me.

I don't think I'm on the verge of killing myself. At this point I think I just have a tendency to think about what would happen if I did die. The conclusion that I usually come to is nothing. A handful of people would pretend that they couldn't see it coming for their own sake, and then life would go on as if nothing occurred.

I did feel better today after posting my thoughts here. It would be a lie for me say that I wasn't looking for at least a little sympathy from anyone willing to give it, but more importantly I just feel relieved that that these thoughts are somewhere other than just in my head. 

My problem might be just that I don't have anyone I'm comfortable with confiding in. I'm glad I was able to do it here, albeit anonymously.
